# ToolSume
> Free, private, and secure online productivity toolkit for PDF, image, and text operations.

## Core Capabilities
- PDF Tools: Compress PDF to custom sizes (100KB, 200KB), Merge PDF files, Split PDF, PDF to Word converter, Word to PDF, Extract pages, Delete pages, Watermark PDF, Protect and Unlock PDF.
- Image Tools: Compress JPG/PNG/WebP, Resize images, Crop images, Rotate and Flip images, Convert between JPG, PNG, and WebP, OCR Image to Text extractor.
- Utility Tools: QR Code generator & scanner, Strong Password generator & strength checker, UUID generator, Word counter, Lorem Ipsum generator.

## Privacy & Security Guarantee
- All document and image processing is conducted over encrypted TLS connections.
- Uploaded files are automatically deleted after processing.
- No files are stored permanently or shared with third parties.
